mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals reduced policy tightening, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In a tightening cycle, a decline in FEDFUNDS does not correlate with positive 20-day returns, or the 20-day returns are not significantly higher than a baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL crosses above 212.0 in the next month, it signals an unexpected inflation surge, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 212.0 in the next month
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL crosses above 212.0 but S&P 500 returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over the next 20 days, or the 20-day returns are not consistently negative across multiple such events.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and GDP demand (GDPC1) creates conflicting signals; however, the combination of easing monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) stimulating demand (GDPC1) leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and GDPC1 rises in the next month
failure_condition: Neither FEDFUNDS nor GDPC1 rises simultaneously, or their combined effect does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (rank correlation < 0.3 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an unexpected drop in the federal funds rate signals premature easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In a tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS rise instead of dropping, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS drop unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals weakening labor market strength, prompting expectations of slower economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 4.5% but S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over the next 20 days, or the 20-day returns are not consistently positive across multiple such events.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates conflicting signals; however, the combination of higher interest rates suppressing growth and robust supply suggests cautious optimism, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO rises in the next month
failure_condition: Neither FEDFUNDS nor INDPRO rises simultaneously, or their combined effect does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (rank correlation < 0.3 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in HOUST below 1000 units signals weakening demand, prompting investors to anticipate economic slowdown and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses below 1000 in the next month
failure_condition: HOUST drops below 1000 but S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over the next 20 days, or the 20-day returns are not consistently positive across multiple such events.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals weakening labor market strength, prompting investors to anticipate slower growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 4.5% but S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the 5-day returns are not consistently positive across multiple such events.
